personas.name: urgent-recent-first-seizure-routine-awake-moderate-priority

personas.name: query-referrer-exclude-epilepsy-guideline-misuse-incomplete
personas.description: The clinical question asks the EEG to confirm this is not epilepsy — NICE NG217 is explicit that EEG must not be used to exclude a diagnosis of epilepsy, so the guideline-misuse flag forces query-referrer even though the requested study (routine awake EEG for suspected-epilepsy) is itself usually-appropriate and carries no red flags; several administrative fields are not yet captured — expect usually-appropriate + routine + low priority + query-referrer, completeness below 100.
